name: Lift.KummerChart.JumpLattice.mem_withExponents_stdExponent_iff
summary: Write x = φ^l x'. Backward: x' ∈ kisinAinf at the letter σ^{−l}(i) has exponents (a, u) ↦ −u, so φ^l x' has the standard exponents (phi_pow_mem_withExponents). Forward: φ^l x' (= x) lies in the φ^l(τ)-saturation of the A_inf-lattice (induction along kisinLocAinf; for a ≥ l the standard exponents show divisibility of the coordinates by φ^a E); applying φ^{−l} puts a power of τ times x' in the lattice; and the Frobenius values of x' are integral by the Hodge basis criterion.

steps.claim: Unfold: φ^l x' ∈ frobKisinAinf(L, l) iff x' ∈ kisinAinf(L); φ^l x' in the letter part at i iff x' at σ^{−l}(i).
The two implications; the letter part in the forward one follows from the hypothesis.

steps.claim: Backward: if x' ∈ kisinAinf(L) (τ^n x' ∈ ainfLattice(L), e) lies at the letter σ^{−l}(i), then x' ∈ withExponents(L, σ^{−l}(i), (a, u) ↦ −u): the value of τ^n x' is in hodgeFil(−u) (valueAt_mem_hodgeFil_of_mem_ainfLattice) and φ^{−a}(τ^n) does not change the step (prime to φ^a E); then phi_pow_mem_withExponents gives φ^l x' ∈ withExponents(L, i, stdExponent(l)).
